title: DeliveryProducerResult
description: A normalized result that an evidence PRODUCER (agent-runner, ci-runner, or the app's dev-deploy mechanism) returns for one operation Factory correlates to a delivery. Producers may expose this directly or Factory may derive it from their existing native record (`runner.run-record`, the `ci.run` state event / `BuildResult`, an app deployment receipt); either way `nativeRef` must let Factory re-fetch the native record and verify it. Factory turns it into `delivery.evidence` with `basis: machine-observation`. It is never acceptance: a successful run, exit 0 or a coordinator approval does not resolve anything. See `docs/task-delivery.md` §Producers for each producer's mapping and the gaps.

operationId.description: The producer's own stable id for the operation (runner run id, `<runId>/<jobId>`, deployment id). Lookup by this id after a restart must return the same result or a later settled one.

revision.description: Full SHA the operation actually ran against, as observed by the producer. `null` when it could not be determined; such a result can never pass a revision gate.

outcome.description: `pending`: still running; poll again. `unknown`: finished or lost without a determinable result. `unavailable`: producer could not be reached or has no such capability.

exitCode.description: Actual exit status; `null` when not reported (never defaulted to 0).

nativeRef.description: Re-fetchable native record reference, e.g. `agent-runner:runs/<id>`. For `app-deploy` it is `<repository>:deployments/<deploymentId>` and resolves to a `delivery.deployment-receipt` (v0.36.0), which carries the rollback identity; see `docs/task-delivery.md` §App-deploy.

environment.description: For `app-deploy`: the running deployment's reported identity and revision. `null` for other producers.

checks.description: Individual commands/jobs/smoke checks inside the operation.

operationKey.description: Factory's reserved key for the request that started this operation (e.g. the runner dispatch). `null` when the producer cannot echo it; Factory then correlates by repository+revision+operationId only and must not assume a match it cannot verify.
